name: Asia Electronic Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Asia Electronic Material Co., Ltd. (AEM) is a Taiwanese enterprise primarily focused on the research, creation, production, and distribution of critical components for flexible electronics. Their product range encompasses both adhesive and non-adhesive flexible copper clad laminates, along with coverlays, stiffeners, and bonding sheets. AEM also manufactures polyimide composite films. These specialized materials are extensively utilized across a broad spectrum of electronic devices, including mobile phones, smartphones, digital cameras, laptops, tablet PCs, LCD monitors, various flat panel displays, printer inkjet and hard drive heads, touch modules, antenna panels, batteries, and LED backlight module light bars. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Jhubei, Taiwan.
